To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
14 viseme identified linguistically for the Malayalam speech and 14 viseme obtained from the data driven approach.
the linguistic knowledge based approach gives better results compared to the data driven approach for the phoneme mapping.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of visemes and allophones from Malayalam phoneme set.
the identification of phonemes and allophone to visemes in Malayalam language based upon linguistic knowledge and data-driven approach.
the identification and mapping of phoneme and visemes in Malayalam language and also the identification and mapping allophone and viseme in Malayalam language.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the data driven approach for phoneme to visemes mapping is more reliable than the linguistic approach.
the data-driven approach is more effective than the linguistic approach.
the linguistic knowledge based approach is more effective than the data driven approach for Malayalam phonemes to viseme mapping.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the many to one mapping is more reliable for the Malayalam phoneme to visememe mapping and many to many allophones to viseme mapping is more reliable in the Malayalam visual domain.
we were able to linguistically identify 14 visemes from 50 Malayalam isolated phonemes and also able to identify 12 visemes from 106 connected words in Malayalam language.
the linguistic knowledge about phoneme and allophoneme mapping in the visual realm is a vital factor in the creation of any visual speech based application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the linguistic knowledge of the language can help to reduce the number of visemes in the visual speech domain.
, a phoneme to visememe and allophone to visememe mapping is possible in the Malayalam Language and can be used for the creation of a visual dictionary.
, we are able to identify the optimum number of viseme for the Malayalam phonemes based on the data clustering algorithm.
